source: Synthetic Heathrow representative airliner paths for Unreal visualisation
note: Lightweight invented path library, not historical surveillance data. Routes are built from long straight legs joined by constant-radius circular turns. Arrivals establish a straight runway-aligned final roughly 17 km before touchdown. Departures remain close to runway heading for roughly 7-10 km before their first turn. No route is produced by mirroring another route.

path_design.curve_type: constant-radius circular fillets between straight legs
